george_jackson2004: Dietrich Jackson came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Dietrich Jackson received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Dietrich Jackson wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dietrich Jackson spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
